Theorem
1. Theorem 5.8\group ch05-viscosity-solutions Source: han-lin-lecture-notes:page-0104, han-lin-lecture-notes:page-0105 ↗ hanlin:ch05-def-5-4 ↗ hanlin:ch05-lem-5-7 Suppose $u\in S^+(\lambda ,\Lambda ,f)$ in $B_1$, $u\geq 0$ on $\partial B_1$, and $f\in C(\Omega )$. If $\Gamma _u$ is the convex envelope of $-u^-$, then \[ \sup _{B_1}u^- \leq c\left(\int _{B_1\cap \{ u=\Gamma _u\} }(f^+)^n\right)^{1/n}, \] where $c$ depends only on $n,\lambda $, and $\Lambda $.

Proof

\sketch Viscosity touching tests control the Hessian of $\Gamma _u$ on the contact set. Apply Lemma 1 to the resulting determinant bound.

□
